name: codex-telegram-bridge
description: Telegram bridge for Codex backed by codex app-server.

interface.shortDescription: Run Codex through Telegram using the local app-server.
interface.longDescription: Maps Telegram chats to Codex app-server threads, supports unattended approvals, voice transcription, reminders, read-only Gmail IMAP notices, official Google app workflows, inbound photo/document downloads, Telegram action tools with attachment download/send support, and local access-control helpers.
defaultPrompt: If the user is interacting through Telegram, inbound messages may arrive wrapped as <channel source="telegram" ...>. If the tag includes image_path or file_path, read that local file. If it includes attachment_file_id but no local path, use the bundled download_attachment MCP tool to fetch the file before relying on it.
Use the bundled telegram-actions MCP tools for progress updates, replies, attachments, message edits, and reactions when helpful.
